label: Retrieval-augmented answering with a verifier
summary: A runnable reference for answering questions from a document collection: versioned chunks, hybrid retrieval, a source filter, an intent check, a verifier that requires the cited passage to contain the value, abstention and a golden set with unanswerable questions held out by product.
runtime: Python 3.11+ with pytest only (the suite runs in under a second); a deterministic extractive reader stands in for the LLM
run: python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
expected: make_data.py prints 132 chunks and 132 golden questions with 36 unanswerable. baseline.py reports on the 66 held-out questions: the naive pipeline answers 60% correctly, hallucinates on 100% of unanswerable questions and makes 6 errors by quoting a changelog, with 100% citation support; the guarded pipeline is correct on every answer it gives, abstains on 27% of answerable questions and hallucinates on none. pytest reports 8 passed.

files.purpose: Synthetic documentation chunks, changelog trap and golden questions with unanswerable cases and a held-out split
BM25, character n-gram similarity, rank fusion, the extractive reader stand-in, the verifier and the two pipelines
Evaluation of the naive and guarded pipelines on held-out products
Executable gates for determinism, split, retrieval, reader, verifier and the safety thresholds

synthetic.description: 132 chunks for 12 products: reference pages for two versions, a changelog per fact quoting old and new values, and tutorials using the same words in other senses. 132 golden questions: latest-version facts, explicit older-version facts and unanswerable questions. Half the products are held out as the test set.
knobs: seed: identical seed gives an identical corpus and question set
PRODUCTS, FACTS and UNANSWERABLE in the file: add products, facts or phrasings

slots.meaning: reference, tutorial or changelog, so factual answers come only from reference pages
the version the user is on, from context first and the question second
what fact the question asks for, so the system can abstain when none is documented
keyword plus similarity rank fusion over chunks
the passage that must literally contain the stated value

data.threshold: pytest -k 'deterministic or disjoint' passes; every chunk has product, version and kind; at least 25% of questions unanswerable
data.how: Run pytest in the kit directory

features.threshold: BM25 ranks the matching document first on a small corpus, and the reader ignores version tags when reading a value

baseline.threshold: Hallucination at least 90% on unanswerable questions and citation support above accuracy (the kit: 100% and 100% against 60%)

challenger.threshold: Hallucination at most 5%, answered precision at least 95%, accuracy 5 points above the baseline, abstention on answerable questions at most 40% (the kit: 0%, 100%, 73% against 60%, 27%)

tests.pass: No product used for tuning appears in the test set
A value absent from the cited chunk, or an abstention, never passes
Naive at least 90% and guarded at most 5%
Answered precision at least 95%, accuracy 5 points above naive, abstention at most 40%, zero stale errors
Naive citation support is at least 99% while its accuracy is below 70%

lessons.evidence: The naive pipeline makes 6 stale-value errors by quoting a changelog that mentions both the old and the new value, each with a valid citation.
On the 18 unanswerable test questions the naive pipeline hallucinated on all of them; the guarded pipeline on none.
The guarded pipeline abstains on 27% of answerable questions because its intent vocabulary is narrow; reviewing abstentions is how the vocabulary grows.
Half the products are held out and never used for tuning, so reported numbers are not the tuning numbers.

target: Each golden question carries the expected value for the right version, or none when the documents never state it. A response is correct only when it gives that value or abstains on an unanswerable question.

headline.baseline: 60% accuracy and 100% hallucination on unanswerable questions
headline.challenger: every given answer correct, 27% abstentions, no hallucination
